summary: VEON Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K press release announcing that its subsidiary Beeline Kazakhstan completed the acquisition of 100% of OLX Group LLP (OLX KZ) from OLX Global B.V. for total consideration of USD 81 million, inclusive of approximately USD 6 million of completion adjustments, following receipt of relevant regulatory approvals. OLX KZ reaches roughly 9 million monthly active users and reported annual revenue just over USD 28 million for the year ending March 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. OLX Group will provide transitional IT services under a handover arrangement; the agreement was originally announced in October 2025. Watch integration execution and Kazakhstan regulatory follow-through.
